<function name="OverrideAlphaWriteEnable" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Overrides the write behaviour of all next rendering operations towards the alpha channel of the current render target.

See also <page>render.OverrideBlend</page>.

<note>Doing <page>surface</page> draw calls with alpha set to 0 is a no-op and will never have any effect.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="enable" type="boolean">Enable or disable the override.</arg>
		<arg name="shouldWrite" type="boolean" default="nil">If the previous argument is true, sets whether the next rendering operations should write to the alpha channel or not. Has no effect if the previous argument is false.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Shows how you can use alpha channel with render targets.</description>
	<code>
render.PushRenderTarget( texture )
render.OverrideAlphaWriteEnable( true, true )

render.ClearDepth()
render.Clear( 0, 0, 0, 0 )

render.OverrideAlphaWriteEnable( false )
render.PopRenderTarget()
	</code>

</example>
